task.description:
WF-01 Step 1 — verify/finalize the DRAFT requirements for PRM-02, PRM-03, PRM-04, PRM-05 (Stage 16, MUST, all DRAFT, batch_queue batch 4c5bcf433769). Note: the four requirements already exist in docs/requirements.yaml with full bodies and multi-clause acceptance criteria (migrated from backlog-migration-20260807 on 2026-08-07). The drafting work is largely done; your task is to:

1. CALL fn:load-requirements and confirm PRM-02 .. PRM-05 are present, well-formed, and that each has at least one substantive acceptance criterion (do not add new criteria unless you find a contradiction or a missing case).
2. AUDIT cross-references: each requirement cross-references the others (PRM-02..PRM-05 are tightly coupled — PRM-02 references PRM-01/03/04/05/ENV-03; PRM-03 references PRM-01/02/04/05/06; PRM-04 references PRM-02/03/05/06/08; PRM-05 references PRM-03/04/06/03/02 + SOL-02 + IDN-05). Verify each cross-reference target exists in docs/requirements.yaml with the expected status (PRM-01 must be RELEASED; PRM-06/08 should be RELEASED; SOL-02 should be RELEASED; IDN-05 should be RELEASED; ENV-03 should be RELEASED). Use fn:load-requirements to confirm.
3. CHECK that PRM-02 .. PRM-05 are consistent with each other:
   - PRM-02 says conflict check runs BEFORE plan digest (PRM-03) and BEFORE review row insert (PRM-04). Verify PRM-03 and PRM-04 do not contradict this ordering.
   - PRM-03 binds approval to plan_digest; PRM-04 stores plan_digest on promotion_reviews; PRM-05 requires approved review before apply. Verify the chain is consistent.
   - PRM-02 (move no version pointer on conflict) and PRM-04 (status moves approved→applied in the same transaction as the pointer move) must not conflict.
4. CONFIRM stage assignment: all four are Stage 16, MUST. PRM-06/07/08/09 (sister requirements) are already RELEASED in Stage 16.
5. WRITE the finalized requirements to docs/requirements.yaml ONLY if you found a defect — otherwise leave the existing bodies untouched. Source attribution: backlog-migration-20260807. last_updated is 2026-08-07 for all four.
6. Do NOT transition the status to VALIDATED — that is WF-01 Step 3 (DOC-UPDATER). Return PASS only if the existing drafts are fit for validation; otherwise return FAIL with the specific issues.

Final note: the previous attempt at this batch (WF02-batch-6-20260812) failed at Step 00a (Green-Main Gate) because ISS-0211/GH-752 was open. GH-752 is now CLOSED (PR #761, commit 9d06bdf4, 2026-08-13T07:21:36Z). The advisory-lock contention fix (SET lock_timeout=0 / SET statement_timeout=0 around pg_advisory_lock acquires; default -j cap 8→4; migration pool_size 2→4) is on main as of commit 9d06bdf4. This is informational only — your Step 1 task is the requirement draft review, not Green-Main Gate verification.
acceptance_criteria: PRM-02, PRM-03, PRM-04, PRM-05 are present in docs/requirements.yaml with status DRAFT
Each requirement has at least one concrete, verifiable acceptance criterion (no vague language)
All cross-references resolve to existing requirements in the canonical document
No contradictions between PRM-02..05 (verified ordering, plan_digest chain, version pointer semantics)
Stage assignment consistent: all four are Stage 16, MUST
If no defects found, return PASS without modifying docs/requirements.yaml
If defects found, return FAIL with the specific issue(s) and a draft remediation
Don't transition status to VALIDATED — that is Step 3 (DOC-UPDATER)

Internal consistency checks (ordering, plan_digest chain, version pointer semantics) found no contradictions. Reqctl validate reports zero issues for the four.
